prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: A cute peach-pink OCTOPUS with rounded peach shaped head, two glossy dark eyes and eight short plump curling arms, little cream suckers. Front upright view, no accessories. Front or top three-quarter view, upright, same orientation throughout. COMMON grade: especially round, lovable and strongly cartoonified, natural recognizable base colors; shrimp must be plump and simplified with BIG friendly eyes and short thick readable legs rather than realistic thin anatomy.  OUTPUT a single animal centered on a square canvas, entire body and appendages inside central 75% of canvas. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
